title: Resend delivered-path effects (remint persists, old token dies, audit row written, resent page) have zero assertions — only the all-failed rollback branch is integration-pinned
detail: AC5 + spec Verify require 'resend (remint + audit + old-token-dead)'; only the all-failed rollback branch is pinned. Delivered-path remint persist, old-token death, audit row and resent page would regress with CI green; the SQL effects are hermetically assertable (the rollback test already queries form_token directly).
recommended_fix: Split the delivered branch into a seam (the any_delivered pattern) or add direct SQL pins: assert new token persists, old token dead, audit_log row written, resent page rendered — no provider 2xx needed.

title: questions.gleam read-side (decode_draft, prefill_for, answer_summary + label_for/truncate) has zero tests — the draft round-trip is pinned write-side only
detail: Resume prefill (AC4 revisit) and the review screen render from these; a regression blanks revisited questions or corrupts review copy with CI green. validate_answer is exhaustively pinned; the inverse read-side has none — asymmetric round-trip coverage.
recommended_fix: Unit-test prefill_for per control (mirror the validate tests: validate → prefill_for → same raw fields), answer_summary per control incl. truncate(140) and review_not_answered, decode_draft corrupt-degrade.

title: clamp_current (?q= deep-link / Back navigation) has zero tests
detail: Every Back/Change link and ?q= deep link runs through clamp_current; no test exercises an answered, unanswered or bogus q= id, so mis-clamping (wrong question shown, snap-to-last regression) ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add integration tests: GET /reference/<token>?q=<id> for answered, first-unanswered and bogus ids; assert the data-current marker and Back links stay consistent.

title: PUT /answer error contract (400 decode/invalid, 404 unknown, 409 closed, honeypot fake-ok) untested — only the 200 happy path is pinned
detail: The JS autosave error contract (400 decode/invalid, 404 unknown, 409 closed, honeypot fake-ok) is unpinned; reference_form.js depends on these statuses, so a contract break passes CI until bug-hunt.
recommended_fix: Add PUT negative integration tests: malformed JSON → 400, unknown token → 404, expired/terminal row → 409, honeypot-filled payload → fake ok:true with nothing persisted.

title: effective() corrected-contact preference (AD-7) untested — a wrong-contact resend regression would pass CI
detail: AC5 resends to 'the effective contact on file' — corrected ?? snapshot (AD-7). Only the snapshot path runs hermetically (both channels skip); the corrected-wins branch is unpinned, so a wrong-contact resend regression passes CI.
recommended_fix: Expose effective() for tests (the any_delivered pattern) and pin corrected-wins-over-snapshot; or seed corrected_email and assert the invite's to_email in a resend integration test.

title: Validation boundary branches unpinned: month_year 1950/2100 + month 01..12, euro_amount 7-digit/positive, bounded_text 200 cap, missing 'to' (Required), plain-Choice happy path, AsStatedAmount as_stated branch
detail: Boundary branches unpinned: year 1949/2101, month 00/13, 8-digit/zero euros, >200-char other-text, missing tenancy 'to' (Required), the plain-Choice happy path and AsStatedAmount 'as_stated' branch — a tightened bound or broken happy path regresses silently.
recommended_fix: Add boundary unit tests at each bound: year 1949/1950/2100/2101, month 00/12/13, euro 0/1/9999999/10000000, other-text 200/201, missing 'to', plain-Choice valid option, salary as_stated.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence: Traceability across chunk 3 (form_handler.gleam + questions.gleam): classify matrix FULL (17 unit cases), is_answer_timing_suspicious FULL (8 cases), format_annual_salary FULL (8 cases), GET state dispatch FULL (8 terminal/takeover/expiry cases integration), POST answer happy+validation-error+honeypot+missing-timing FULL (4 integration), stamp-once FULL, rollback-remint FULL, any_delivered/resend_audit_details FULL, registry+next_unanswered+previous FULL, validate_answer ~90% (per-control happy + core error, boundary holes). P0/P1: no gaps. P2/P3 gaps: delivered-resend effects, read-side (prefill_for/answer_summary/decode_draft), clamp_current, PUT negatives, effective(), boundaries ≈18% of behaviour surface → overall ≈82%. Tests verified by reading (real DB-level assertions, not tautological); suite not re-run in this worktree.
detail: P0 100%, no P1 gaps (P1 = 100%), overall ≈82% ≥80% → PASS. Suite is dense on the session critical path; the two warning gaps (read-side, delivered-resend) are the only meaningful exposure.
recommended_fix: Pin the two warning gaps — read-side (prefill_for/answer_summary/decode_draft) unit tests and delivered-resend SQL-effect assertions — to harden AC3/AC4/AC5 coverage toward a high-confidence PASS.
